learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to use the terminology in fluid mechanics and has an ability to explain the meaning of the central concepts in fluid mechanics, the principles behind the fundamental equations and how these equations can be simplified.
The student has an ability to explain the basic idea of dimensional analysis and to apply it in fluid mechanics e.g. for the scaling of model test results.

The student is able to solve simple problems in fluid mechanics e.g. to determine the flowrate, pressure loss or pump head in pipe system and to determine forces or moments on bodies or characteristics of rotating flow machinery based on fluid velocity.

syllabus_topics: control volume approach and conservation principle in fluid mechanics
energy equation, losses and the extended Bernoulli equation
potential flow and superposition of solutions
boundary layer and flow around bodies
